stories.label: Still waiting · World · Due process
stories.head: Dr Hussam Abu Safiya
bullets: Gaza hospital director held since 27 Dec 2024.
A Beersheba court extended his detention six months on 18 Nov, his lawyer says.
Israel alleges Hamas links; his family denies them.

photo.alt: A tall pale stone office building with a curved glass centre, behind palm trees and a busy road.
photo.caption: The courthouse in Beersheba, Israel, in 2009. File photo.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Press
stories.head: Dawit Isaak
bullets: Journalist held incommunicado since 23 Sep 2001, never charged or tried.
19 Nov marked 21 years since his last contact with family.
Eritrea's president said in 2009 there would be no trial and no release.

photo.alt: A busy street of low buildings with blue minibuses, parked cars and people walking, with a green hill behind.
photo.caption: A street in Asmara, Eritrea's capital, in 2007. File photo of the city.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Press
stories.head: Sai Zaw Thaike
bullets: Myanmar Now photojournalist seized on 23 May 2023 covering Cyclone Mocha.
Serving 20 years for sedition; reportedly denied kidney treatment.
Given CPJ's press freedom award on 19 Nov; the ministry did not respond to CPJ.

photo.alt: A closed iron gate between white pillars with plaques, trees behind and a parked car beside it.
photo.caption: The main gate of Insein Prison, Yangon, in 2013. File photo.

stories.label: Still waiting · India · Due process
stories.head: Umar Khalid
bullets: Held since 13 Sep 2020 under UAPA; trial not begun.
His third Supreme Court bail plea, filed 4 Nov, is not yet listed.
Delhi Police call his pleas premature under a one-year bar.
stories.src: IANS · Citizens for Justice and Peace

photo.alt: A closed blue and white iron gate under a blue canopy with a Hindi sign reading Central Jail Tihar.
photo.caption: The entry gate of Tihar Jail, Delhi, in 2024. File photo.
